label: Teltonika RUT260
description: A two-port industrial router with LTE Cat 6: 1 WAN + 1 LAN at 10/100, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. The Cat 6 modem is the difference from the RUT200, and it is why the cellular interface is modelled at 300M instead of 100M.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT260 datasheet v1.1: 1 x WAN port 10/100 Mbps, IEEE 802.3/802.3u/802.3az; 2 x Ethernet ports total; Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n; LTE Cat 6, modelled at the 300 Mbps downlink class rather than the Cat 4 units' 100M.
